title: The Final Synchronization
summary: With the Void Core shattered, Ha-Jun anchors the ten Relics into a permanent celestial constellation within his soul, achieving true Sovereign transcendence.

panels.shot: the quiet expanse of low earth orbit bathed in clean golden sunrise
panels.action: The sun rises over the eastern horizon of Earth, bathing the atmosphere in breathtaking amber, rose, and gold light.
panels.prose_en: The sun rises over the eastern horizon of Earth, bathing the atmosphere in breathtaking amber, rose, and gold light.
panels.prose_hi: Surya prithvi ke purvi kshitij par ugta hai, aur vatavaran ko lubhavani embar, gulabi aur sunhari roshni se nahla deta hai.

panels.shot: the shattered fragments of the void entity dissolving into starlight
panels.action: Billions of black debris particles turn to sparkling diamond dust, burning harmlessly in Earth's upper thermosphere.
panels.prose_en: Billions of black debris particles turn to sparkling diamond dust, burning harmlessly in Earth's upper thermosphere.
panels.prose_hi: Arbon kale malbe ke kan chamakdar heere ki dhul mein badal jaate han, jo prithvi ke upari tharmospheer mein hanirahit roop se jalte han.

panels.shot: ha-jun floating peacefully in orbit looking down at the blue planet
panels.action: Ha-Jun hovers weightlessly, his dark coat drifting in the zero gravity; the blue oceans and white clouds reflect in his eyes.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Earth is safe... We actually saved our home.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun hovers weightlessly, his dark coat drifting in the zero gravity; the blue oceans and white clouds reflect in his eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun bharahin hokar mandrata hai, uska kala coat shunya gurutvakarshan mein bah raha hai; neele sagar aur safed badal uski aankhon mein pratibimbit hote han.

panels.shot: tae-jun floating beside him resting his armored hand on ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Tae-Jun floats beside him, helmet retracted, smiling warmly with tears in his eyes: 'You did it, Little Sovereign.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Mum and Dad would be so proud of you, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun floats beside him, helmet retracted, smiling warmly with tears in his eyes: 'You did it, Little Sovereign.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun uske bagal mein tair raha hai, helmet peeche hata hua hai, aankhon mein aansu ke saath garmjoshi se muskura raha hai: 'tumne yah kiya, little soweren.'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling softly leaning his head on his brother's shoulder
panels.action: Ha-Jun rests his forehead against Tae-Jun's shoulder for a brief, vulnerable second: 'We did it together, Hyung.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hum dono ne mil kar kiya, Tae-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rests his forehead against Tae-Jun's shoulder for a brief, vulnerable second: 'We did it together, Hyung.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne ek sankshipt, samvedansheel kshan ke liye Tae-Jun ke kandhe par apna matha tikaya: 'hamane ise ek saath kiya, hung.'

panels.shot: kuro perching on ha-jun outstretched finger ruffling black feathers
panels.action: Little Kuro sits on Ha-Jun's fingertip, cooing softly: 'The ten relics have reached perfect vibrational harmony.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: It is time for the final soul-seal.

panels.prose_en: Little Kuro sits on Ha-Jun's fingertip, cooing softly: 'The ten relics have reached perfect vibrational harmony.'.
panels.prose_hi: Nanha Kuro Ha-Jun ki ungaliyon par baitha hai aur dheere se sahala raha hai: 'das avashesh purna companatmak samanjasya tak pahunch gaye han.'

panels.shot: all ten relics manifesting around ha-jun in a perfect geometric mandala
panels.action: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Devourer, and Hourglass form a ten-pointed star of living light.
panels.prose_en: Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Devourer, and Hourglass form a ten-pointed star of living light.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh, anguthi, haddi, hridy, pankh, aankh, janjeer, mukut, bhakshak, aur ghantaghar jeevit prakash ka das-nukila tara banate han.

panels.shot: the ten relics rotating clockwise around ha-jun torso
panels.action: The relics spin faster, blurring into a continuous ring of liquid rainbow mana that wraps around his heart.
panels.prose_en: The relics spin faster, blurring into a continuous ring of liquid rainbow mana that wraps around his heart.
panels.prose_hi: Avshesh teji se ghumte han, taral indradhanush man ki ek satat anguthi mein dhundhla ho jaate hain jo uske dil ke charon or lipatne lagta hai.

panels.shot: the relics sinking directly into ha-jun chest one by one
panels.action: One by one, each relic sinks into Ha-Jun's chest, leaving glowing permanent tattoos of ancient runes on his skin.

dialogue.text: Ten relics... Forged into one beating heart.

panels.prose_en: One by one, each relic sinks into Ha-Jun's chest, leaving glowing permanent tattoos of ancient runes on his skin.
panels.prose_hi: Ek-ek karke, pratyek avashesh Ha-Jun ki chhati mein sama jata hai, jisse uski tvacha par prachin runs ke chamakdar sthayi tattoo ban jaate han.

panels.shot: the final relic, the fallen feather, dissolving right over his sternum
panels.action: Kuro's Mythic Fallen Feather sinks into the very center of his chest, blossoming into a radiant purple phoenix crest.
panels.prose_en: Kuro's Mythic Fallen Feather sinks into the very center of his chest, blossoming into a radiant purple phoenix crest.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ka pauranik gira hua pankh uski chhati ke bilkul beech mein dhans jata hai, aur ek chamakdar baingani phoenix shikha mein khil jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun body bursting with a gentle, soothing pulse of absolute mana
panels.action: A soft, non-destructive shockwave of warm violet light washes across all of low Earth orbit, clearing space debris.
panels.prose_en: A soft, non-destructive shockwave of warm violet light washes across all of low Earth orbit, clearing space debris.
panels.prose_hi: Garm baingani prakash ki ek naram, gair-vinashakari shockwev prithvi ki nichli kaksha ko paar kar jaati hai, jisse antriksh ka malba saaf ho jata hai.

panels.shot: system notification interface flashing in pure platinum text
panels.action: The golden interface upgrades to platinum: '[BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 100% - THE TRUE DEMON SOVEREIGN TRANSCENDED]'.
panels.prose_en: The golden interface upgrades to platinum: '[BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 100% - THE TRUE DEMON SOVEREIGN TRANSCENDED]'.
panels.prose_hi: Golden interface platinum mein upgrade hota hai: '[bladlin sinkronization: 100% - sachcha danav samprabhu sthanantrit]'.

panels.shot: ha-jun new appearance: platinum-black hair and royal sovereign attire
panels.action: His hair is long, midnight-black streaked with starlight silver; his coat is woven of living shadow and star-dust.
panels.prose_en: His hair is long, midnight-black streaked with starlight silver; his coat is woven of living shadow and star-dust.
panels.prose_hi: Uske bal lambe han, aadhi raat ke kale rang ki taron wali chandi ki dhariyan han; uska coat jeevit chhaya aur taara-dhul se buna gaya hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun inspecting the glowing crest on his own right forearm
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks at his own forearm: a matching bronze crest of the Aegis pulses in harmony with Ha-Jun's heart.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Our bloodlines are permanently linked. Where you walk, my shield follows.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun looks at his own forearm: a matching bronze crest of the Aegis pulses in harmony with Ha-Jun's heart.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apne agrabahu ko dekhta hai: agis ki ek mail khati hui kansya shikha Ha-Jun ke dil ke saath taalmel bithati hai.

panels.shot: the brothers smiling and turning their gaze back down toward earth
panels.action: The brothers exchange a warm, confident look, then orient their boots toward Seoul.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Let's go home, Hyung. The city is waiting.

panels.prose_en: The brothers exchange a warm, confident look, then orient their boots toward Seoul.
panels.prose_hi: Bhai ek-dusre ko garmjoshi se bharte hue, aatmavishwas se dekhte han, phir apne jute seoul ki or modate han.

panels.shot: the three warriors re-entering earth's atmosphere in shooting-star streaks
panels.action: Three brilliant golden shooting stars streak across the morning blue sky, descending toward Seoul.
panels.prose_en: Three brilliant golden shooting stars streak across the morning blue sky, descending toward Seoul.
panels.prose_hi: Teen shandar sunhare tutate taare subah ke neele aakash mein seoul ki or utarte hue chamakte han.

panels.shot: gwanghwamun square in central seoul under bright morning sunshine
panels.action: Gwanghwamun Square: thousands of citizens, hunters, and demon soldiers fill the boulevard in joyous anticipation.
panels.prose_en: Gwanghwamun Square: thousands of citizens, hunters, and demon soldiers fill the boulevard in joyous anticipation.
panels.prose_hi: Guangwamun squir: hajaron nagarik, shikari aur rakshas sainik khushi ki pratyasha mein buleward ko bhar dete han.

panels.shot: the three shooting stars landing gracefully in the center of the square
panels.action: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, and Kuro land feather-light on the granite paving stones; no shockwave, only a gentle warm breeze.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, and Kuro land feather-light on the granite paving stones; no shockwave, only a gentle warm breeze.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, aur Kuro granite farsh ke pattharon par pankh-roshani lagate han; koi jhatka nahin, keval halki garm hawa.

panels.shot: absolute silence falling over the hundred thousand people assembled
panels.action: One hundred thousand people fall completely silent, holding their breath as they look at the two brothers.
panels.prose_en: One hundred thousand people fall completely silent, holding their breath as they look at the two brothers.
panels.prose_hi: Jab ve donon bhaiyon ko dekhte hain to ek lakh log puri tarah chup ho jaate han, apni saansein rok lete han.

panels.shot: captain baek stepping forward tears streaming down his weathered cheeks
panels.action: Captain Baek steps forward, his ceremonial sword lowered, saluting with a trembling hand: 'Supreme Sovereign...'
panels.prose_en: Captain Baek steps forward, his ceremonial sword lowered, saluting with a trembling hand: 'Supreme Sovereign...'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake aage badhte han, unki aupcharik talwar neeche hoti hai, aur kampate haath se salami dete han: 'sarvocch samprabhu...'.

panels.shot: ha-jun sheathing the sanguine fang with a crisp, echoing click
panels.action: Ha-Jun slides his blood blade into its scabbard; the hilt clicks shut with an echoing, decisive sound.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun slides his blood blade into its scabbard; the hilt clicks shut with an echoing, decisive sound.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne khoon ke blade ko uski myan mein daal deta hai; mooth ke click ek gunjti, nirnayak dhwani ke saath band ho jaate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling warmly at the crowd speaking with his natural teenage voice
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with the gentle warmth of a 17-year-old boy: 'The war is over. Earth is free.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Jung khatam ho chuki hai. Hum sab surakshit hain.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles with the gentle warmth of a 17-year-old boy: 'The war is over. Earth is free.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek 17 saal ka ladke ki saumya garmjoshi ke saath muskurata hai: 'yuddh khatm ho gaya hai. prithvi swatantra hai.'

panels.shot: the entire square erupting into deafening, tearful celebration
panels.action: One hundred thousand voices roar in ecstasy; confetti, flowers, and hats fly into the bright morning sky.

dialogue.speaker: citizens
dialogue.text: LONG LIVE THE DEMON SOVEREIGN!! LONG LIVE THE BROTHERS!!

panels.prose_en: One hundred thousand voices roar in ecstasy; confetti, flowers, and hats fly into the bright morning sky.
panels.prose_hi: Ek lakh aawajen parmanand mein garjana karti han; comfeddi, phool aur topiyan ujjwal subah ke aakash mein udti han.

panels.shot: min-jae sprinting through the confetti tackling ha-jun in a hug
panels.action: Min-Jae sprints through the crowd, leaping into Ha-Jun in a wild, sobbing bear hug, knocking his glasses crooked.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: You absolute madman!! You actually pulled it off!!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae sprints through the crowd, leaping into Ha-Jun in a wild, sobbing bear hug, knocking his glasses crooked.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je bheed ke beech se teji se daudta hai, Ha-Jun mein jangli, siskate hue bhalu ke aalingan mein chhalang lagata hai, jisse uska chashma tedha ho jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun laughing catching min-jae glasses before they fall
panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs, catching Min-Jae's glasses with a flick of his fingers and slipping them back on his nose.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Told you I wouldn't die, Min-Jae.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs, catching Min-Jae's glasses with a flick of his fingers and slipping them back on his nose.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun hansta hai, apni ungaliyon ke jhatke se min-je ke chashme ko pakadta hai aur use wapas apni naak par rakh deta hai.

panels.shot: demon warriors and human hunters hugging and shaking hands across the square
panels.action: Tough Iron Demon captains and elite Section 9 hunters embrace, clinking beer cans and sharing tears.

dialogue.text: A new treaty of eternal brotherhood was written that morning.

panels.prose_en: Tough Iron Demon captains and elite Section 9 hunters embrace, clinking beer cans and sharing tears.
panels.prose_hi: Tuff iron danav kaptan aur vishisht section 9 ke shikari gale milte han, beer ke dibbe khanakate hain aur aansu bahate han.

panels.shot: tae-jun putting his arm around ha-jun shoulder as they look at the celebration
panels.action: Tae-Jun wraps his arm around Ha-Jun's shoulder, smiling warmly at their friends: 'What do we do now, little brother?'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ab kya plan hai, Sovereign Sahib?

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun wraps his arm around Ha-Jun's shoulder, smiling warmly at their friends: 'What do we do now, little brother?'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne Ha-Jun ke kandhe par apna haath lapeta aur apne doston ko dekhkar garmjoshi se muskurate hue kaha: 'ab hum kya karen, chhote bhai?'.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling sheepishly rubbing the back of his neck
panels.action: Ha-Jun blushes slightly, rubbing his neck: 'Well... Tomorrow is Monday. I think I have a math exam at Saint Mirren.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Kal Monday hai... Mujhe Saint Mirren mein Calculus ka exam dena hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun blushes slightly, rubbing his neck: 'Well... Tomorrow is Monday. I think I have a math exam at Saint Mirren.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun thoda sharmata hai, apni gardan ragadata hai: 'thik hai... kal somwar hai. mujhe lagta hai ki sent miren mein meri ganit ki pariksha hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun, min-jae, and kuro bursting out into helpless, joyful laughter
panels.action: Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Kuro burst into wild laughter under the blue sky, Kuro shaking his feathers on Ha-Jun's head.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: A God who fears Calculus. Perfect.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Kuro burst into wild laughter under the blue sky, Kuro shaking his feathers on Ha-Jun's head.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun, min-je, aur Kuro neele aakash ke neeche zor se hansne lage, Kuro ne Ha-Jun ke sir par apne pankh hila die.

panels.shot: the group walking down gwanghwamun avenue into the golden morning sunlight
panels.action: The two brothers, their best friend, and their mythic crow walk down the wide avenue into a bright, peaceful new world.

dialogue.text: THE DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — CHAPTER 82 CONCLUDED.

panels.prose_en: The two brothers, their best friend, and their mythic crow walk down the wide avenue into a bright, peaceful new world.
panels.prose_hi: Do bhai, unke sabse acche dost, aur unka pauranik kauwa ek ujjwal, shantipurna nai duniya mein chaude raste par chalte han.
